summary: Tested the singles-only bet slip (parlays admin toggle, OFF by default) in both backend and frontend. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass. /api/config returns {parlays:false}. A parlay POST /api/bets returns 400 'Parlays are currently unavailable — single bets only'. A single with 2 selections returns 400. A $1 single as admin succeeded and was voided, and the balance came back to exactly where it started. /api/boosts returns [] while parlays are OFF and the multi-leg combos are filtered out. /api/admin/parlays requires admin (401 when logged out). Cash out is OFF and auto-settle is OFF (manual grading on); neither was changed. Frontend: with 2 picks from different games there is no Single/Parlay toggle, the singles-only note shows, the button reads 'Place 2 Bets', and a $5 stake shows a $10.00 total. The Boosted Odds strip is hidden while OFF. Turning the admin toggle ON shows 'ON — tap to turn off', /api/config returns parlays:true, and after reload the Single/Parlay toggle appears, 'Place Parlay' works and the boosted combos strip appears. Turning it back OFF was verified: config parlays:false and the slip is back to singles only. Parlays are LEFT OFF.

minor.issue: The parlay guard runs after _verify_selections, so a parlay with stale odds or unavailable picks returns 409 (odds changed) instead of 400 'parlays unavailable'. Moving the _parlays_on check before _verify_selections would give a clearer error and avoid unneeded price lookups.

ui_bugs.issue: Heavy live favourites show odds of 1.00 and can still be clicked into the slip, giving zero profit. The backend rejects price<=1 as unavailable (409). This existed before this change.

action_items: Optional: move the parlay-disabled check before _verify_selections in place_bet
Optional: disable or hide odds buttons with price <= 1.00
critical_code_review_comments: BetSlip renders twice (desktop sidebar + mobile drawer), so data-testids are duplicated. Tests must use .first.
server.py is over 4000 lines and should be split into modules
seed_data_creation: One $1 USD single bet placed as admin, then voided via admin grade (refunded, balance unchanged). The voided bet record remains in the bets collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Parlays setting is db.settings _id 'parlays' and is left OFF. Cashout is OFF and auto-settle is OFF. Use .first for bet-slip testids because the slip is duplicated. Log in via page.request.post /api/auth/login (cookie).
